boundary.zh: Open Exchange Rates 官方 v0.7 JSON REST API，覆盖 latest、historical、currencies、time-series、convert、OHLC 与 usage 七个只读 Endpoint 及官方附加查询参数。
boundary.en: The official Open Exchange Rates v0.7 JSON REST API covering the seven read-only latest, historical, currencies, time-series, convert, OHLC, and usage endpoints plus officially documented query parameters.

launchLedger.nextAction: An @pontx scope administrator must make @pontx/open-exchange-rates@0.1.0 anonymously installable; then repeat registry fresh-install, metadata admission, Preview, Production, and production acceptance.

contractSource.license: terms-reviewed; independently authored metadata and SDK/CLI code only

convertSuccessContract.evidence: The official ReadMe document.api.schema embedded in /reference/convert includes a 200 application/json schema and a complete Result example with disclaimer, license, request, meta, and response.

independentImplementationPolicy.scope: Independent metadata, generated SDK, and CLI code only
requirements: Do not copy supplier documentation prose, OpenAPI source, SDK source, marks, credentials, or market data into published artifacts.
Hub must not proxy, cache, persist, or display supplier responses.
SDK and CLI callers provide their own App ID directly to the supplier service.

derivedProbeFixes: normalized the ReadMe colon date path to an OpenAPI path template
replaced six hyphenated operationIds with code-generation-safe identifiers
removed the generated dangling schemas import because the official OAS declares zero component schemas

quality.local: contract, generated-source, typecheck, 4/4 unit tests, ESM/CJS/declarations, CLI dry-run credential redaction, 2/2 built E2E, tarball fresh-install, and release gate passed

registry.npmPublish: npm publish --access public reported success on 2026-08-16
registry.visibilityMutation: npm access set status=public returned 403 Forbidden
registry.freshInstall: blocked because the registry package cannot be resolved

blockers.zh: 独立仓库 pontjs/open-exchange-rates 的 commit 53377dca 已完成 7 Endpoint / 17 Schema 的调用方直连 SDK/CLI，Node 18/20/22 CI、4/4 单元测试、2/2 built E2E、tarball fresh-install 与 release gate 均通过，npm publish --access public 也回显成功。但匿名和认证 registry 查询 @pontx/open-exchange-rates@0.1.0 均返回 404，干净安装无法开始；当前身份将包设为 public 时返回 403。没有真实 registry fresh-install 证据，不能准入目录。
blockers.en: Commit 53377dca in pontjs/open-exchange-rates completes a caller-direct SDK/CLI for seven Endpoints and 17 Schemas; Node 18/20/22 CI, 4/4 unit tests, 2/2 built E2E tests, tarball fresh-install, and the release gate all pass, and npm publish --access public reported success. But anonymous and authenticated registry lookups for @pontx/open-exchange-rates@0.1.0 return 404, so a clean registry install cannot begin; setting the package public with the current identity returns 403. Without real registry fresh-install evidence, it cannot enter the catalog.

nextAction.zh: 由拥有 @pontx scope package visibility 权限的 npm 管理员使 @pontx/open-exchange-rates@0.1.0 可匿名解析和安装；随后在全新目录完成 ESM/CJS/types、pontx-open-exchange-rates help/preview/安全路径的 registry fresh-install 复验，再准入 metadata、Preview、Production 与生产验收。
nextAction.en: An npm administrator with @pontx scope package-visibility permission must make @pontx/open-exchange-rates@0.1.0 anonymously resolvable and installable. Then repeat registry fresh-install checks for ESM/CJS/types and pontx-open-exchange-rates help/preview/safety paths, followed by metadata admission, Preview, Production, and production acceptance.
